class.name: SpineAnimationTrack
class.brief_description: Composes Spine animations with Godot's AnimationPlayer and animation editor.
class.description: Add this node directly beneath a [SpineSprite] or [SpineSprite3D]. It drives that sprite's shared controller, so playback, mixing and editor scrubbing use the same Spine animation state in 2D and 3D. Available in both Godot4 module and GDExtension builds. The helper creates an [AnimationPlayer] child (or uses an existing one) and generates clips named after the skeleton's animations. The [code]_looped[/code] suffix loops the Spine animation; [code]-- Empty --[/code] mixes to an empty Spine track. Generated clips/libraries are managed by this node and are rebuilt when its skeleton resource changes. Create a separate master [AnimationPlayer] and add animation-playback tracks targeting these child players. Select and scrub the master in Godot's animation editor to preview the Spine poses, including when the master uses a custom [member AnimationMixer.root_node]. Multiple helpers can drive different Spine track indices. Key the helper properties below to control mixing and playback options. Set [member blend_tree_mode] when using an [AnimationTree] instead of the master animation editor workflow. The generated [member animation_name] and [member loop] properties are internal keyed values, not inspector controls. A scrubbed pose stays paused when the animation editor closes or switches to another player. A track that is not targeted by the active animation editor leaves newly requested sprite preview animations alone. Runtime updates require the sprite's normal process/physics update, or an explicit [method SpineSprite.update_skeleton] / [method SpineSprite3D.update_skeleton] in manual mode. See example16 for one master AnimationPlayer driving 2D and 3D sprites together. Godot3 module builds support the 2D sprite only.

method.name: update_animation_state
method.description: Internal callback connected to the parent sprite's before_animation_state_update signal. Passing another sprite does not retarget this node; reparent the helper instead.
